_doc: Emergent NPC questlines, the Spelunky 2 way (round 39, reworked in round 3 of the owners board: people stay, thank you, and pay now or later). Nothing is announced: no HUD text, no list. `npcs` are the people: hub lines per stage; `thanks` is said in the hub the first time you visit after the stage was reached; `chat` are idle lines said when you swim up to someone who has already been helped; `react` is what they shout when a bomb goes off near them; `hurt` / `angry` belong to npcs.js; Quill has `relics` lines; the host has `outcomes` for a won wager. `quests` are the encounters met in the levels: a row is eligible when the person's stage is between `need` and `max` (inclusive) on one of the listed levels (0 = Shallows 1-1), rolls `chance` once per level, and when finished moves the stage up by exactly one (unless `stage` is false). kinds: vault (sealed in a rock pocket: bomb it open), rescue (a cage on a floor: break it with a dash or a bomb), meet (someone standing in a side cave: swim up to them). lines: meet, ask (said as you approach), help (when you act), thank (right after). OUTCOMES (rows and the host): one is picked per encounter, seeded by the dive seed, the level and the person, by `weight`. `lines` are said at once; `now` is a reward given at once; `role` (rescue only) is 'follow' (the critter follows you to the exit, `now` is paid there) or 'stay' (it stays and swims about its cage); `later` brings the person (or `npc`/`variant`/`name`: someone else) back `after` [min, max] levels further down the same dive, waiting near the exit (`where` 'exit') or in the rest grotto ('rest'; also when the due level is past the last one), saying `lines` and giving `reward`; `next` is a gift kept in the save and handed over in the hub (`lines`, `boon`: applied when the next dive starts). Rewards: {shells}, {bombs}, {hearts}, {juice}, {item: items.js id}. Boons: {bombs}, {shells}, {juice}.

npcs.name: Marlo
npcs.title: The Stranded Diver

1: Fresh air at last. Thank you!
The current keeps burying me down there. Dig me out again, if you find me.
2: One more rescue, and I will make it worth your while.
3: A ring in the floor, straight to the third cave. It is yours.

thanks.1: Out of the rock! Find me at the hub.
thanks.2: Free again! You are getting good at this.
thanks.3: Three times! There is a shortcut waiting in the hub.

chat: I will catch my breath here a while.
Go on, I will be fine.
angry: I have a harpoon, you know.

npcs.name: Quill
npcs.title: The Collector

1: Old octopus idols, my friend. Carved stone, heavy, slightly cursed.
Carry one out through the exit ring, and it is mine.
2: My lantern burns for you now.
Every dive starts a little brighter.

relics: A relic! Splendid. Two more, if you would.
The second! The shelf is filling up.
Three! You have outdone yourself. The lantern is yours.

thanks.1: Ah, a new neighbour. Mind the ledge.
thanks.2: Take my lantern on every dive.

chat: Carved stone, my friend. Always carved stone.

npcs.name: The Host
npcs.title: The Pool Host

1: The champion of the round basin!
I am on holiday. Even hosts need one.
Five shells, twenty seconds. You know the deal.

thanks.1: Moved in. The pool can run itself for a while.

lines: Bravo! A little extra from the house.
The house owes you one. I will find you further down.
There you are, champ!
The house pays its debts.
What a show! Come back any time.
I will save you something at the hub.
Champ! I saved you a bomb or two. Take them on your next dive.

hurt: Sir! This is a respectable pool!

lines.meet: Hey! Over here! In the rock!
lines.ask: Blow this wall open, would you?

lines: Here, all I had in my pockets.
I dug these out of the rock. Take them.
I have nothing on me now.
Look for me near an exit further down.
There you are! I kept my word.
Salvage from a wreck. It is yours.
I will leave something for you at the hub.
I found these while you were out. For your next dive.

quests.done: The diver waves, free at last

lines: I will follow you home.
Squee! (Pip swims happy circles.)

later.name: Pip's Mama
lines: You freed my little Pip!
Take this. A mother does not forget.
Squeak! (Pip will bring you something!)
Squeak! (Pip found shiny shells for you!)

quests.done: It squeaks happily and swims home

lines: Squeak! (Shiny!)
Squee... (Pip just wanted to say hello.)
Squeak! (Mama is further down!)

later.name: Pip's Mama
lines: Pip told me about you.
Here, for the road.

lines.ask: Come, come. I do not bite.
lines.help: Out on a dig, as you see.
lines.thank: Always a pleasure to meet a fellow collector.

lines: Here, a little something for your trouble.
The old idols rest on pedestals, one cave in three.
Lift one, and the ceiling comes down. Swim fast!
Meet me in the grotto at the end of the dive. I will have something for you.
Ah, you made it!
A few drops of fish juice. Fresh, I promise.
Take these old goggles. They see into stone.
